notes.title: Report #06 : April 2025 Progress
notes.content:
Welcome, Inspectors.

Long time no see! We're still alive and kicking, and we’re bringing a lot of big (and hopefully good) news.

[h1]A bug a day keeps the dev away~[/h1]

The first episode is still our main priority, but life is hard—and so is game development. We’ve encountered a lot of problems that naturally come with making a game.
But our team is working really hard to bring you the best version of Vanova’s Stories!

We also added a lot of juice to our various UI elements to give everything a bit more energy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/f5e49ceae61e863f3c8aa44d0836eb2a1c03c0cc.gif[/img]
Everything is better when it moves.

[h1]Testing the Second Investigation[/h1]

The second investigation is done! But now we need to test it to make sure there’s nothing that could stop you from enjoying it.
Nothing major, but when working with a lot of elements, small issues can creep in—things you wouldn’t expect or even think were possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/bfee0c40bf70f0cee1869af39b46de27d9df4309.png[/img]
I mean, technically we are a small game… so it fits?


[h1]Cleaning the Third Investigation[/h1]

All the graphic assets for the third and final investigation are done. Maps, characters, and clues—everything’s ready.
Now we just need to add a little bit of game developer magic to tie it all together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/ecf786c905b5c1a20cbabf76af7454891ab9ce56.png[/img]
Yes, this is a serious episode. Trust us.

Next Objective: Releasing the Game

Yes—finally! The game is coming out on the 12th of this month!

You’ll be able to play the first episode, and the next ones will arrive over the following months as free updates.

We’re so excited to finally show you the work we’ve done over the past few months. We hope you’re as interested as we are happy!

We’ll keep you updated on the progress of each part. Don’t hesitate to follow us on social media for exclusive images:

Twitter: https://x.com/VanovasStories

LinkedIn: https://fr.linkedin.com/company/madgik-yarn-studio

Thank you so much for your patience and support. We can’t wait to show you what we’ve poured so much love into!

End of Report.

notes.title: Report #05 : December 2024 Progress
notes.content:
Welcome, Inspectors.

We are excited to welcome you at the start of this year, which promises many great things, the best of which is the release of the game (yes, really!).


[h1]Tutorial[/h1]

The tutorial is complete. We are now in the debugging phase to ensure everything works smoothly for an upcoming demo. We’re waiting for the last issues to be resolved, like characters showing up where they shouldn't, before presenting it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/7d16bf8ece83ef9644eac46049281cd2913c5c6b.png[/img]
Beginnings are always humble.

[h1]Sound Implementation[/h1]

We have started implementing the various music tracks and sounds sent to us by our partner. We’ve chosen to use a dynamic sound system. 
Each inspector will have their own instrument, which will blend into the music as soon as they enter the room.
It’s a metaphor for the idea that everyone brings their own energy, and together, we can create the most beautiful symphony. It’s poetic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/2bf1e00a85d3cbea09501b00dc2ea6fe4e045006.png[/img]
Yes, it’s a bit hard to convey sound through an image, but imagine a great tune.

[h1]Investigation 03[/h1]

The first character sketches have been completed. We’re now in a more... serious environment? A good outfit is essential, though everyone manages to add their own... personal touch. Let’s say that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/f08f13deaf20cc90be5b1e847924a365ecf41490.png[/img]
Aren’t they serious?

The next goals will be:

- Finish the dialogues for Investigation 03
- Continue progress on Investigation 02
- Work on the missing graphic elements

We will keep you updated on the progress of these different elements. Don’t hesitate to follow us on our social media for exclusive images.

[b]Twitter[/b] https://x.com/VanovasStories

[b]LinkedIn[/b] https://fr.linkedin.com/company/madgik-yarn-studio

We wish you a great start to the year and will be back next month with new updates!
Thank you for your support—we continue working to offer you the best experience possible!

End of Report.

notes.title: Repport #01 : June 2024 Progress
notes.content:
Welcome inspectors.

We're delighted to see you again. Despite the heat, we're making good progress. (but it's still hot as hell here).

[h2][b]Menus and Feedbacks[/b][/h2]

We've added feedbacks to liven up the dialogs. Given that you'll be reading (a lot), we're keen to keep them as lively as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/50c39d5d0ecca92235b98d573a8f1fcb84c2aa7b.gif[/img]

We also add animations to menus. Whether it's a map that appears or a new item obtained, each will have its own behavior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/1647a115e1ebeb608a62c0e9d7bee2c04d19f5b0.gif[/img]

We'll continue to add feedback to make the gameplay ever more satisfying.

[h2][b]Episode 02 dialogues[/b][/h2]

As well as adding juice to our various menus and dialogues, we're starting to work on the narrative and discussion trees for episode 02.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264352/54e05d79bb470e2e93c2a98e1f4a23717e5596a8.png[/img]
[i]A glimpse of the new conversations, as serious as ever.[/i]

[h2]Our next objectives[/h2]

- Continue polishing existing elements.
- Finish and edit the dialogues from episode 02.
- The start of concept art for the elements of episode 02.

We'll keep you posted on progress. Don't hesitate to follow us on our networks for exclusive images.

[b]Twitter[/b] https://x.com/VanovasStories

[b]Linkedin[/b]  https://fr.linkedin.com/company/madgik-yarn-studio

Thank you for your support, we'll continue to work hard to bring you the best possible experience!

[i]End of report[/i]
